story_description: Implement the hooks builder pipeline, canvas, and inspector views.
task_description: Hooks need a data model representing the visual pipeline with nodes, connections, and configurations.
atom_description: Hooks need a data model representing the visual pipeline with nodes, connections, and configurations.
problem_statement: Hooks need a data model representing the visual pipeline with nodes, connections, and configurations.
scope_in: HooksPipeline model with nodes array and connections array; HookNode model with type, position, config; HookConnection model
Implement HooksPipeline.swift according to the problem statement and functional requirements.
scope_out: Pipeline execution; canvas rendering; JSON conversion to settings.json
Exclude work assigned to other atoms or features in this epic.
assumptions: Nodes can be triggers, actions, or filters
Blaze app builds successfully with `swift build` before work begins
@AppStorage is the persistence mechanism for user preferences
Actor-based stores (HookStore pattern) are the standard for data persistence
constraints: Must be Codable for persistence
Position stored as CGPoint for canvas
Must not block main UI thread
Must use glass styling via DSGlass for all settings panels
Must support keyboard navigation (accessibility)
Must persist state across app restarts
All user-facing strings must be localizable (use String constants)
No third-party dependencies without explicit approval
At least one event node per graph
UpdatedInput only under PreToolUse or PermissionRequest with allow
Stop gate only under Stop or SubagentStop with loop safety
Conflict resolution: continue false wins, deny beats allow, ask beats allow, PostToolUse block forces remediation
Exit 0 success, stdout visible in verbose; UserPromptSubmit and SessionStart may inject into context
Exit 2 blocks with error handling per event
Other exit codes are non-blocking and continue execution
Event nodes: PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PermissionRequest, UserPromptSubmit, Notification, Stop, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, PreCompact, SessionStart, SessionEnd
Filter nodes: Matcher and Predicate
Action nodes: Command, Prompt, Agent
Control nodes: Decision Allow Deny Ask, Permission Decision, Block with Reason, Continue or Stop
Transformation nodes: Updated Input, Additional Context, System Message
Utility nodes: Logger, Export Trace, Rate limit or Debounce
Left panel node palette with Events, Filters, Actions, Utilities
Center panel canvas with pan, zoom, and grid background
Right panel inspector with node properties, tooltips, and validation errors
Top bar actions: Back, Save, Discard, Test run, Export
Space plus drag to pan canvas
Cmd plus scroll to zoom
Cmd C and Cmd V to copy and paste nodes
Delete to remove node
Cmd S to save, Cmd Enter to test run, Cmd Z to undo, Cmd Shift Z to redo
Cmd I to focus inspector, M to toggle minimap
functional_requirements: HooksPipeline contains nodes and connections arrays
HookNode has: id, type, eventType, config dictionary, position
HookConnection has: id, sourceNodeId, targetNodeId, sourcePort, targetPort
Support all hook events: PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PermissionRequest, UserPromptSubmit, Notification, Stop, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, PreCompact, SessionStart, SessionEnd.
Support node taxonomy for events, filters, actions, control, transformation, and utility nodes.
Persist graph with nodes and edges and validate against semantic rules.
nonfunctional_requirements: Must not block the main UI thread.
data_model_changes:
struct HooksPipeline: Codable {
var nodes: [HookNode]
var connections: [HookConnection]
func exportToSettings() -> [String: Any]
func validate() -> [HookValidationError]
}
struct HookNode: Identifiable, Codable {
let id: UUID
var type: HookNodeType
var eventType: String?
var config: [String: AnyCodable]
var position: CGPoint
}
/// Node type categories aligned with F005-R000 Node Taxonomy (27 types total)
enum HookNodeCategory: String, Codable, CaseIterable {
case event       // 12 types: Trigger nodes
case filter      // 2 types: Matcher, Predicate
case action      // 3 types: Command, Prompt, Agent
case control     // 4 types: Decision nodes
case transform   // 3 types: Output construction
case utility     // 3 types: Logging, tracing
}
enum HookNodeType: String, Codable, CaseIterable {
// Event Nodes (12) - Triggers
case preToolUse, postToolUse, postToolUseFailure, permissionRequest
case userPromptSubmit, stop, subagentStart, subagentStop
case sessionStart, sessionEnd, preCompact, notification
// Filter Nodes (2)
case matcher, predicate
// Action Nodes (3)
case command, prompt, agent
// Control Nodes (4)
case decisionAllowDenyAsk, permissionDecision, blockWithReason, continueStop
// Transformation Nodes (3)
case updatedInput, additionalContext, systemMessage
// Utility Nodes (3)
case logger, exportTrace, rateLimitDebounce
var category: HookNodeCategory {
switch self {
case .preToolUse, .postToolUse, .postToolUseFailure, .permissionRequest,
.userPromptSubmit, .stop, .subagentStart, .subagentStop,
.sessionStart, .sessionEnd, .preCompact, .notification:
return .event
case .matcher, .predicate:
return .filter
case .command, .prompt, .agent:
return .action
case .decisionAllowDenyAsk, .permissionDecision, .blockWithReason, .continueStop:
return .control
case .updatedInput, .additionalContext, .systemMessage:
return .transform
case .logger, .exportTrace, .rateLimitDebounce:
return .utility
}
}
var displayName: String {
switch self {
case .preToolUse: return "Pre Tool Use"
case .postToolUse: return "Post Tool Use"
case .postToolUseFailure: return "Post Tool Use Failure"
case .permissionRequest: return "Permission Request"
case .userPromptSubmit: return "User Prompt Submit"
case .stop: return "Stop"
case .subagentStart: return "Subagent Start"
case .subagentStop: return "Subagent Stop"
case .sessionStart: return "Session Start"
case .sessionEnd: return "Session End"
case .preCompact: return "Pre Compact"
case .notification: return "Notification"
case .matcher: return "Matcher"
case .predicate: return "Predicate"
case .command: return "Command"
case .prompt: return "Prompt"
case .agent: return "Agent"
case .decisionAllowDenyAsk: return "Decision (Allow/Deny/Ask)"
case .permissionDecision: return "Permission Decision"
case .blockWithReason: return "Block with Reason"
case .continueStop: return "Continue/Stop"
case .updatedInput: return "Updated Input"
case .additionalContext: return "Additional Context"
case .systemMessage: return "System Message"
case .logger: return "Logger"
case .exportTrace: return "Export Trace"
case .rateLimitDebounce: return "Rate Limit/Debounce"
}
}
var icon: String { // SF Symbol names
switch category {
case .event: return "bolt.fill"
case .filter: return "line.3.horizontal.decrease.circle"
case .action: return "play.fill"
case .control: return "arrow.triangle.branch"
case .transform: return "arrow.triangle.2.circlepath"
case .utility: return "wrench.fill"
}
}
}
struct HookConnection: Identifiable, Codable {
let id: UUID
var sourceNodeId: UUID
var targetNodeId: UUID
}

No additional runtime event protocol is introduced.
ui_states: No UI state; this atom is a data model or service component.
UI rendering is handled by view atoms that consume this component.
Idle saved state with no unsaved changes
Dirty state with unsaved changes and save enabled
Validating state during schema and semantic checks
Error state with validation errors and save disabled
Saving and Saved states with success toast
Discard confirm modal when leaving with unsaved changes
ui_interactions: No direct UI interactions; behavior is driven by callers.
Public methods are invoked by views or managers when needed.
Drag nodes from palette to canvas and connect ports to create edges.
Select node to edit config in inspector with tooltips and examples.
Run test execution and display validation results.
ui_copy: No user-facing strings are introduced by this atom.
Any internal log text must avoid sensitive data.
Top bar buttons: Back, Save, Discard, Test run, Export.
Inspector shows short tooltip and long learn more text for each node.
failure_modes: Invalid JSON on decode - throw error
If persistence fails, log an error and keep the previous value.
rollback_plan: Remove model; hooks only via JSON

Verify persistence round trips when settings are updated.

perf: Ensure settings changes apply without visible jank.

Verify file permissions for any on-disk artifacts.
